applies_why: The judge text resolves a challenged link about Isaiah 7:14 by comparing what CR2 answered against what DR3 presses.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse - I weighed (1) reading it to let the judge call the link underdetermined because the sign verse itself does not state the mechanism, and (2) reading it to require weighing the competing chains' footing rather than a single verse's statement.
why: The judge relies on what one sign verse does not state, not on a chain-against-chain footing comparison, and so uses the retired stating-verse approach.
